high_level_description: This image is a stylized representation of a chessboard with a minimalist design. The chessboard is set against a black background, which makes the light brown squares and the white and dark pieces stand out prominently. Chessboard: The chessboard is divided into 64 squares, alternating between light brown (white) and dark brown (black). The pieces are arranged in a standard starting position for a chess game. The pieces include: White pieces: King, Queen, Rook, Bishop, Knight, and Pawns. Black pieces: King, Queen
